We're looking for a Building Surveyor to join our Colliers Project Leaders team in Auckland.
This is an exciting opportunity to further develop your career within a leading property and project consultancy. Working alongside experienced Building Surveyors and project professionals, you'll gain exposure to a diverse range of consultancy services, including building inspections, technical due diligence, defect investigations, maintenance planning, insurance assessments, and project management.
You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of projects, build trusted client relationships, and develop your technical expertise while being supported by an experienced team committed to your professional growth.
At Colliers Project Leaders, we actively support professional development, industry accreditation, and career progression, giving you the opportunity to shape your career while contributing to projects that make a lasting impact on New Zealand's built environment.

Undertake building surveys including condition assessments, technical due diligence inspections, measured surveys, access audits, and compliance reviews
Prepare high-quality technical reports, schedules, and client deliverables
Carry out defect assessments, investigations, and maintenance planning activities
Assist with insurance assessments, reinstatement projects, and claims-related work
Support the delivery of project management services including contract administration, procurement, and project coordination
Monitor construction works and provide site observations and progress reporting
Participate in client meetings and contribute technical advice and recommendations
Liaise directly with clients, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities
Assist with business development activities and contribute to maintaining strong client relationships
Contribute to a high-performing team culture focused on technical excellence and client outcomes
The Value You'll Add
Degree qualified in Building Surveying, Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline
Approximately 2 to 4 years' experience in building surveying, consultancy, construction, property, or a related field
Working knowledge of building construction methods, building pathology, and maintenance planning principles
Understanding of relevant New Zealand building legislation, codes, and industry standards
Ability to undertake inspections and prepare professional reports with minimal supervision
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and written communication skills
Well-developed organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
Proactive and client-focused, with a collaborative approach to working within project teams
Working towards, or interested in pursuing, NZIBS and RICS accreditation
Strong Microsoft Office skills
Full New Zealand driver's license

We’re proud to be recognised as a 2026 finalist in the Best Places to Work awards, reflecting our commitment to creating an exceptional workplace culture. Some of the benefits we offer include:
Colliers Academy, a 12-month programme to accelerate your career in property
Mentoring from industry experts

An inclusive and social culture with regular team events
Additional leave benefits, including Loyalty and Volunteering leave
